test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
'Which of the following statements are CORRECT:

a) The Sarhul festival is celebrated in Jharkhand.

b) Sal tree flowers are collected and offered to God during the Sarhul festival.

c) The flowers of the Sal tree symbolise the fertility of Earth.
solution:
The correct answer is __**All a, b and c.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarhul** festival is celebrated in **Jharkhand** by the tribal communities to **worship nature** and its elements.
 
• During the Sarhul festival, **Sal tree flowers** are collected and offered to God as they symbolize the **fertility** of Earth.
 
• The Sarhul festival marks the beginning of **spring **and is celebrated to seek blessings for a good harvest.
 
• The festival is also a symbol of **unity and brotherhood** among the tribal communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sal tree** is a sacred tree in Hinduism and is also known as **Shala tree**.
 
• Its wood is used for making **furniture, boats, and agricultural tools.**
 
• The tree is also known for its** medicinal properties** and is used in Ayurvedic medicine.
 
• Sarhul festival represents the **start of the new year**.
 
• The celebration lasts for **three days**, starting on **Sukla Paksh**'s third day of the month of Chaitra and ending on **Chaitra Purnima**.
 
• The Sarhul festival is also celebrated in other states like** Odisha and Bihar**, but with different rituals and traditions.
